title: Edelstahl-Mechanik GmbH — claimed by payload
description: DE · Manufacturing · Edelstahl-Mechanik GmbH is a German manufacturing company based in Göppingen. The company specializes in laser metal processing, including 2D and 3D laser cutting and welding, as well as structural sheet metal fabrication. Its products and services are applied in industries such as mechanical engineering, the automotive sector, construction, medical technology, and the food industry.
